role: The note block (id 25): right-click steps its TileEntityNote pitch and queues a block event that plays the note; redstone power would also play it.

members.name: BlockNote
members.note: row 25: wood material, tile entity flag

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: power edge detection; world.conf redstone = off makes isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered always false, so field_145880_i never changes

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: case ID_NOTEBLOCK: note = (note + 1) % 25, then func_145878_a's air-above test, the instrument from the material below and the block event

members.name: onBlockClicked
members.note: No state: TileEntityNote.func_145878_a queues a block event whose server half plays a sound and spawns a particle the server world drops, and whose client half does the same (no draws under the pinned minimal particles). idx-blocks-s1 left-clicks a note block (the dig starts and stops) with every row matching.

members.name: onBlockEventReceived
members.note: The note sound and particle: no state on either side (see onBlockClicked).

notes: TileEntityNote holds the pitch; its NBT round-trip is in tileentity.c. survival.c lists id 25 among the blocks whose activation the client answers true. The block event's sound and particle carry no state. lane/idxblocks: idx-blocks-s1 left-clicks and right-clicks a note block on a stone base.
